lines.text: God speaks from Zion, with consuming fire before Him, and summons the heavens and the earth to judge His people.
God calls His saints, who made a covenant by sacrifice, and says He does not rebuke them for their burnt offerings.
God needs no bull or goats, for every beast of the desert and the cattle on a thousand hills are His.
God tells His people to sacrifice a thank offering and promises that if they call on Him in trouble, He will teach them.
God tells the wicked they hate His instruction and slander their own brother, and that He will now rebuke them.
